exactTheorem.statement: For a G-equivariant selector f:D->X, any G-fixed input d can map only to a G-fixed output f(d). If X^G is empty, no deterministic selector exists.
exactTheorem.finiteModel: C4 acts transitively on four compass directions while the input datum is C4-fixed.

minimalEscape.interpretation: One transforming orientation datum is sufficient; the law remains equivariant, but the input is no longer symmetry-fixed.

innerConjugationBoundary.conclusion: Every inner block-sign grade assigns the same grade to an arrow and its reverse.

universalRealityBoundary.conclusion: Extending one ordinary real structure to the full three-family Yukawa sector forces this CP-odd invariant to vanish, while complex Hermitian data need not.
